why: Each small top shape goes inside the bottom shape of the OTHER pair (the triangle went into the circle, the plus went into the square). So the circle goes into the square and the plus goes into the triangle: option 2. Option 3 is wrong because it puts each shape into its own bottom shape.
trick: Watch where each small shape travels; here they cross over to the other pair.
